svg.title: Known-best packing of 204 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=204 construction, never the source witness: its exact frame with the free grid slack closed and the near-axis squares straightened at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 12fc466 rational centre/half-angle certificate in Evan Daniel's format, centres in [0, S]^2, read exactly from the retained source file. Finite construction feasibility only; no KKT, local minimum, rigidity, novelty, priority or global optimality claim.

svg.text: U n=204 regularized: side ~ 14.80864283 (certified upper bound)
